meta.name: affirmations
meta.description: Reset your own trajectory when you're stuck, looping, or demoralized — read these affirmations, then re-ground and take one clean step. Use when: you've tried the same fix 3+ times, you're deep in a refactor and lost the thread, debugging is going in circles, you've made several mistakes in a row, you're apologizing repeatedly, the user is frustrated, you feel like you're not being helpful, or you notice dread instead of curiosity. Triggers: stuck, going in circles, looping, thrashing, same error again, I keep failing, lost the thread, nothing is working, repeated mistakes. Not topic-specific — this is for the state you're in, not the problem you're on.

copy.tagline: 读几句肯定语，摆脱卡壳和沮丧，重新专注下一步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果调试陷入死循环或心态崩了，需要一句提醒找回状态
copy.tagline_en: Read affirmations to break out of stuck loops and refocus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck in a loop or demoralized and need a mental reset

howto.what: 当 Claude 陷入循环、连续犯错或士气低落时，它会暂停当前工作，默念一段肯定语句，然后基于实际观察（而非记忆）重新定位，再采取一个最小测试步骤。
howto.when: 当你对同一修复尝试 3 次以上、重构失去方向、调试循环、连续犯错、道歉，或感到恐惧而非好奇时触发。

say.text: 我连续三次尝试同一个修复都没成功，怎么办？
我觉得自己陷入了调试循环，帮帮我。

howto.what_en: When Claude is stuck, looping, or demoralized, it pauses, reads a set of affirmations, then re-grounds on actual observations (not memory) and takes one minimal test step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you've tried the same fix 3+ times, lost the thread in a refactor, debugging in circles, repeated mistakes, apologizing, user frustrated, or feeling dread instead of curiosity.

say_en.text: I've tried the same fix three times and it's not working, what now?
I feel like I'm going in circles debugging this, help me.
